title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct wavelengths for maximum reflection in the visible spectrum.

title: Constructive Interference
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify the condition for constructive interference in thin films.

title: Correct Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must use the correct equation relating thickness, refractive index, and wavelength.

title: Integer Values
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply integer values for k to find valid wavelengths.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the equation.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or alternative methods for finding wavelengths.
